reviewFlags.issue: The page at the owner's PVBI60-NB link titles the oven PVBI60-NI (stainless, black glass door). The owner confirms it is the unit he sells; only colour-independent facts and the stainless finish from that page are published.

That page gives oven and cut-out dimensions (595 × 494 × 595 mm and 560 × 550 × 589 mm, D × H × W) whose heights look wrong for a 60 cm built-in oven. Not published; confirm with ProView or the importer.
The owner's PVBI60-BK link renders no product text for our fetcher, so nothing was compared or merged from the black variant.
